title: Linked notebook plot and record selection
scenario: Real Mojo PlotSpec and Scene, source-key selection, linked details, independent outputs, bounded comm and lifecycle recovery
backend: Mojo native Scene/SVG subprocess; installed anywidget; local JupyterLab and Chrome headless
fixture: 12 synthetic assay rows; 64-record capacity; two linked outputs and independent FDG
reproduce: See examples/linked_notebook/README.md. Build wheel and native executable, assemble source-free bundle, install into clean environment, run capture.py with Python -I, then gallery.py. Parent used MOXI_P05_CONSUMER=/tmp/moxi-p05-parent-consumer and MOXI_NOTEBOOK_PORT=8919. Evidence includes emulated DPR2 and labeled synthetic cancellation; physical input, remote hosts and screen readers unverified.
